name: median_lifestyle_anchor
unit: hours of other people's labour per median US adult per year

interval.basis: MEDIAN_LIFESTYLE_RESULT.md headline: 'about 1,350-1,400 hours'. A stated range, not a statistical confidence interval.

method: Four tracks summed: (1) domestic embodied labour = BLS employment-requirements matrix 2023 x PCE final demand, jobs x 1,800 h/job, median/mean 0.80; (3) foreign labour in imports = EXIOBASE 3 2022 pxp; (2) housing structure annualised by holding time; (4) own-pollution remediation labour. Tracks 1+3 are computed per capita (1,276 h) and normalised to the median adult.
